source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 339 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-339.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 339 was established by Ordinance No. 20793, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 14, 1990. Ordinance No. 20793 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20793; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-339.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 339 is established on property generally fronting on the southwest line of Dragon Street, northwest of the northwest line of Wichita Street. The size of PD 339 is approximately 0.344 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20793; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-339.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20793; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-339.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the site/landscape plan (Exhibit 339A). (Ord. Nos. 20793; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-339.105. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the site/landscape plan. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 20793; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-339.106. USES.

(a) The only uses permitted on the Property are those uses allowed in an IR Industrial Research District and a juvenile facility.

(b) For purposes of this article, a juvenile facility means a facility that provides residential treatment, care, detention, supervision, or education of persons subject to the control of the Texas Youth Commission or the Texas Department of Human Services.

(c) The term “persons subject to the control of the Texas Youth Commission or the Texas Department of Human Services” is limited to youth who have been adjudged delinquent by the courts of this state and committed to the Texas Youth Commission or who have been determined by the Texas

Department of Human Services to require Level V care under the Level of Care Standards adopted by the Texas Health and Human Services Coordinating Council.

(d) Nonresidential social services and educational programs for these youth and their families will also be permitted as part of this use. (Ord. Nos. 20793; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-339.107. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Parking for a juvenile facility must be provided in accordance with the site/landscape plan. Parking for any use permitted in an IR Industrial Research District must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 20793; 25850)

sections.title: Number Of Residents
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-339.108. NUMBER OF RESIDENTS.

No more than 20 residents are permitted in the juvenile facility. (Ord. Nos. 20793; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-339.109. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20793; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-339.110. ZONING MAP.

PD 339 is located on Zoning Map No. J-7. (Ord. Nos. 20793; 25850)
